predecessors.name: Kingdom of Great Britain
predecessors.text: the British colony of Seychelles (a separate crown colony from Mauritius since 1903) and, from 23 June 1976, Aldabra, Farquhar and Desroches, held by the British Indian Ocean Territory since 1965

ledger.x: 1976: Seychelles becomes independent from the United Kingdom as a republic.
1976: Aldabra, Farquhar and Desroches return to Seychelles.

certainty.note: An island state: coast and outer islands.
